CustomField.description: Salted hash of the six-character code the person keeps. They hold the code; we hold only this. It lets somebody turn off a standing disclosure from a text message without us ever knowing who they are, which is the only way an anonymous channel can honour a withdrawal.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Never shown to staff. The person's own copy of the code is the only readable one.
CustomField.label: Claim Code Hash
